svg.title: TsaoDFT evidence-first DFT research operating system
svg.desc: Hero-centric dark scientific interface with an AI-assisted molecular, periodic and HPC montage, compact capability modules, workflow gates and evidence cards. Illustrative only, not computational or scientific data.

g.text: Every claim has a support edge.

svg.text: From molecular states to periodic materials · from electrons to kinetics
From calculation to accepted evidence · from data to defensible claims
No silent state transitions · no unsupported claims
AUDIT TRAIL · METHOD FINGERPRINT · ARTIFACT HASH · ACCEPTANCE GATE · CLAIM SUPPORT
minimum ≠ transition state · normal termination ≠ scientific acceptance
surface / defect / adsorption comparisons require a shared fingerprint
DFT labels · uncertainty · kinetics · HPC lineage
model score and scheduler success never replace evidence
